reason: I only buy what a friend or partner already uses, and nobody I know has Nexio. 89 dollars a month is a lot when I earn about 20,000 a year, and my clients are already in Telegram and Excel.
objection: Moving my data from amoCRM or Excel will take weeks, and there is no migration help included. I do not want to stop selling to set this up and then find it does not fit.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or another company I know recommending it, plus free data migration from amoCRM or Excel and a Starter price nearer 40 to 50 dollars.
